entries.purpose: The Claude NO-GO remediation must be declared as its own serial delivery unit before its scope may change implementation sources. The current manifest is accepted as the explicit pre-remediation baseline; this addendum does not make any future manifest byte untracked.

Historical round-two reviewer coverage must remain immutable when a declared post-remediation delivery unit is introduced. This baseline permits only a fail-closed denominator distinction between historical reviewed units and explicitly declared current remediation units.
